name: Recruit training
explanation: Boot camp. JST dates: 1 July 1997 to 5 September 1997. Earlier site copy had September–November 1997; the JST window is the one used here.

name: Advanced Electronics Technical Core
explanation: Introductory electricity and electronics before rating school. Service School Command, Great Lakes. 21 January 1998 to 5 June 1998.

name: Electronics Technician Radar Strand Class A
explanation: ET Class A, radar strand. Service School Command, Great Lakes. 10 July 1998 to 13 October 1998.

name: Petty Officer Indoctrination
explanation: Petty Officer Indoctrination at Service School Command, NTC Great Lakes. JST records the completion date 9 July 1998.

name: General Purpose Electronic Test Equipment Repair and Calibration
explanation: Repair and calibration of general-purpose electronic test equipment. Technical Training Unit, Keesler AFB, Mississippi. 12 January 1999 to 28 April 1999.

name: Field Calibration Activity Maintenance
explanation: Field calibration of Navy METCAL test equipment. Technical Training Unit, Keesler AFB. 29 April 1999 to 19 May 1999.

name: Surface Basic Calibration Technician Pipeline
explanation: Pipeline course recorded on the JST at Keesler AFB, completion 19 May 1999, after FCAM.

name: Safety Programs Afloat
explanation: Safety Programs Afloat at the Naval Occupational Safety, Health and Environmental Training Center, Norfolk. Completion 27 April 2001. Qualifying course for NEC 9571.

name: Afloat Hazardous Materials Coordinator
explanation: Afloat Hazardous Materials Coordinator at the same Norfolk safety schoolhouse. Completion 31 August 2001.

name: First Line Leadership Development Program
explanation: First Line Leadership Development Program at Afloat Training Group Western Pacific, Yokosuka, Japan. 26 November 2001 to 7 December 2001. Junior petty-officer leadership course. Not Chief Indoctrination.

name: Quality Assurance Officer/Supervisor Course
explanation: Quality Assurance Officer/Supervisor Course. JST completion 8 September 2003. Schoolhouse not named.

name: Instructor Training Paperbased-Mobile Team Training
explanation: Instructor training, paper-based mobile team, Fleet Training Center San Diego. Completion 19 December 2003. Lines up with NEC 9502 dated 20 January 2004.

name: Communications Security COMSEC Maintenance Technician
explanation: COMSEC maintenance technician course at Center for Surface Combat Systems, Learning Site San Diego. 5 April 2004 to 23 April 2004. Lines up with NEC 1460.

name: Naval Special Warfare Communications
explanation: Naval Special Warfare Communications at Naval Special Warfare Center, Coronado. Completion 3 September 2004. Lines up with NEC 9613 dated 12 November 2004.

name: Primary Leadership Development Program
explanation: Primary Leadership Development Program at Submarine Training Center Pacific, Yokosuka. 1 August 2005 to 11 August 2005. Next course in the same leadership series as FLLDP.

name: Alcohol And Drug Abuse Managers/Supervisors (ADAMS) For Supervisors
explanation: ADAMS for Supervisors at Center for Personal and Professional Development Detachment DAPMA, Norfolk. Completion 18 October 2007.

name: Combat Lifesaver
explanation: Army Combat Lifesaver correspondence course. JST completion 10 March 2010.

name: SERE 100 Code of Conduct
explanation: SERE 100 / Code of Conduct course through Joint Warfighter Center (JKDDC), Suffolk. Completion 28 August 2011.

name: Command Fitness Leader
explanation: Command Fitness Leader course at Naval Air Station Jacksonville. Completion 26 June 2015. Lines up with NEC 95PT (later 8CFL).
